title: Radio: MED 1, 19:52–19:56: St. Brendan's Refuses LC-0421, Air 7 Delayed, LRMC Near Its Limit

lines.from: St. Brendan's Community Hospital, Nursing Supervisor
lines.text: Larkfield, St. Brendan's. We will NOT accept LC-0421, the head injury with a deficit. Our CT is down and we have no neurosurgery. We can take one more Delayed, and that's it. St. Brendan's stays on Limited intake.

Larkfield, Air 7 is leaving Lakeshore now. The ceiling is about 900 feet in rain, so our turnaround is running 25 minutes. Earliest I'm back at your LZ is 20:20, and I'm the only aircraft up tonight. Air 7 clear.

Larkfield, LRMC nursing supervisor. LRMC has taken 7 Delayed since the incident began. The SOP first-hour limit was 8. The surge ward is filling. Coalition, we need you to start moving our stable inpatients to Lakeshore under SOP-MC-02 section 5 now, or I go to Limited intake by 20:30.

fields.voiceStyle: Three speakers on a hospital radio. St. Brendan's: woman in her 50s, firm and clipped, no room to argue. Air 7: man in his 40s, flat, measured pilot cadence over rotor-cockpit noise. LRMC: woman in her 40s, tired and fast, rising urgency on the last sentence.

instructorNote: This inject puts pressure on destination decisions: LC-0421 belongs at Lakeshore because of the injury, not the distance. Watch for the Medical Group to hold LC-0421 for Air 7 and log the reason, and for the IC to set the order for the other two Immediates. MEDCOM should record the St. Brendan's and LRMC limits on the paper board, and the Coalition Coordinator and IC should weigh moving LRMC inpatients to Lakeshore under SOP-MC-02 section 5 against letting LRMC go to Limited intake, and look for a second aircraft or a ground option to Lakeshore.
